title: Smoked Dutch Pilaf with Velvety Touch
description: A creamy twist on traditional pilaf, featuring velvety texture and smoky flavor.

ingredients.name: Velvety cream
ingredients.notes: Heavy cream or half-and-half work as substitutes

ingredients.name: Dried thyme
ingredients.notes: Fresh thyme can be used as a substitute

instructions: Cook the smoked Dutch sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned.
Remove sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the rice pilaf mix to the skillet and cook according to package instructions.
Stir in the velvety cream, chicken broth, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
